message.content:
A reflection across a line in 2D reverses orientation, so its determinant is \(-1\).

To verify, for the line spanned by \(\begin{pmatrix}1\\5\end{pmatrix}\), the reflection matrix is

\[
\mathbf{R}=2\frac{vv^T}{v^Tv}-I,
\]

where \(v=\begin{pmatrix}1\\5\end{pmatrix}\). Since \(v^Tv=1^2+5^2=26\),

\[
\mathbf{R}=\frac{2}{26}\begin{pmatrix}1&5\\5&25\end{pmatrix}-I
=
\begin{pmatrix}
-\frac{12}{13} & \frac{5}{13}\\[2mm]
\frac{5}{13} & \frac{12}{13}
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

Then

\[
\det \mathbf{R}
=
\left(-\frac{12}{13}\right)\left(\frac{12}{13}\right)
-
\left(\frac{5}{13}\right)^2
=
-\frac{144+25}{169}
=
-1.
\]

The answer is \(\boxed{-1}\).
